# Naming forwarding-pointers

The rename chain for the box-threshold atom, oldest → newest. Every rename leaves
one entry here (maintained by `expedition rename`); anchors re-emitted after each.

- `hbox` → `(box)`  (rename, 2026-07-02)
- `(box)` → `atom`  (rename, 2026-07-06)
- `atom` → `DecoratedPeelStep`  (rename, 2026-07-10)
- `DecoratedPeelStep` → `DecoratedDescent`  (rename, 2026-07-13)
